target_customer: Clinical research sites (site owners and directors) running trials
problem: Clinical trials need more skilled staff than the industry has; research sites spend staff time on manual multi-visit data entry and quality control.
business_model: B2B software/AI agent for clinical research sites

founders.name: Oliver Keh
founders.background_notes: Says on joingleam.com/about he has spent his career on the technology side of healthcare. The site lists Michael Felix as CTO.

founders.name: Michael Felix
founders.role: CTO (per company site; not on YC page)
founders.background_notes: Listed as CTO on the company about page; not a confirmed co-founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Browser agent entering data across any EDC (Veeva, Medidata, Oracle logos shown) is moderately hard integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Little evidence read; workflow integration may create some lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying the wedge. Later AI-for-trial-sites entrants (Research Grid, Ryght AI, 2024-25) are separate startups, not incumbents.

market_need_then: YC description cites a shortage of skilled clinical trial staff; the company site says research sites spend coordinator time on manual EDC entry. No dated third-party demand data was found.

identity.mascot_or_character: Gleam Dude, a cheerful 'employee of the month' who loves data entry and QC
identity.visual_style: Playful, game-like (a small 'Game over' game on the about page)

branding.community_and_virality: Runs its own podcast (Note to File) and stream blog; no evidence of fan or press attention to the brand.

brand_strength.rationale: A distinctive mascot and consistent playful voice on the company site, but no external evidence of recognition; the real-word name is shared with other companies (for example the unrelated radiology AI firm Gleamer appears in searches).

outcome_analysis: Gleam, YC S23, started as AI to run clinical trials and now sells an agent that moves source data into EDC systems for research sites, with testimonials from two site owners (one claiming a 95% cut in work per visit). No funding, exit or shutdown was found; a third-party estimator (Latka) claims $2.6M 2025 revenue and 24 staff, unverified, against a YC listing of 4. Outcome unresolved, with a clear niche but unknown funding and several AI trial-ops startups raising money since 2024.
notes: No funding found in searches (YC page, welcome.ai, aggregators); unknown is not zero. Competition: searches found no sources dated near mid-2023, so the list is empty; Research Grid (seed 2024-11) and Ryght AI (2025) are later entrants. YC page lists founded 2026, which conflicts with the S23 batch; founded_year left null. The earlier depth-1 'pivot' was inferred from differing descriptions, not sourced, and has been removed. Latka revenue and headcount are unverified estimates. Name origin not found.
